Ladakh deploys ex-servicemen to enforce environmental protection

Ladakh has established an Environment Protection Force, comprising 100 former army personnel, to address ecological threats. This initiative aims to curb activities like off-roading that endanger the region's environment. The deployment marks a significant step in enforcing environmental regulations in the sensitive area.
